question: How does Kali relate to virtuous persons vowed to helping others?
premises: Some virtuous persons are vowed to helping others.
Kali can stand in different relations to humans.
Service to the good reverses Kali's usual dominance.
inference: Kali becomes the servant of virtuous persons vowed to helping others.
plain_english: Kali is the servant of the good who are vowed to helping others.
